# onnxruntime C API headers

Verbatim copies of the ONNX Runtime C API headers needed to build the plugin
execution provider (`include/onnxruntime/core/session/` upstream). They define
`ORT_API_VERSION`, which `onnxruntime>=1.30` in `requirements.txt` must match;
sync them together on ORT upgrades and keep the files unformatted.
